text:
alex: quick triage — we have overlapping vendor announce windows and need a clear priority + fallback plan. current asks: H100/H200/B200 want late-Apr press, MI300 is pushing mid-Apr, Gaudi team flagged driver slip. who owns gating (firmware, si cert, marketplace image)?

mira: can you drop a tiny matrix? i can pull lab readiness + perf smoke. PMs are pushing for dates. :eyes:

sam: heads up — gaudi driver fw v1.2.3 RC slipped ~5 days. new ETA Apr 21 (was Apr 16). that blocks image bake and some SI tests.
jordana: marketplace images require vendor-signed SKU tags. we can stage provisional tags for canary, but final tags need vendor signoff + legal checklist.
alex: provisional tags ok as short-term. @sam can you paste the minimal blocker commands/steps so eng-ops can try parallel work?
sam: sure — minimal steps:```bash
# build canary image
docker build -t rwd/gaudi-canary:staging-170250 
# push provisional tag
docker push rwd/gaudi-canary:staging-170250 
# create canary deploy
rwdctl deploy create --image rwd/gaudi-canary:staging-170250 --env canary=true
```
mira: i can run a perf smoke by Apr 20 if the canary image is ready. can we also plan a fallback to H200/B200 if supply hits a blocker?
jordana: fallback ok but note H200 vs B200 perf diff — release notes + ops mapping needed. we need a mapping table for token limits, batch sizes.
nate: fyi spoke with vendor reps — nvidia said embargo shift +/-3 days possible if hardware constrained. arm partner (mi300) wants firm Apr 18 and is less flexible. recommend prioritizing MI300 if we must pick one.
alex: proposal: prioritize MI300 announce Apr 18, schedule Gaudi canary Apr 22, and target H100/H200/B200 public announce Apr 26 (give vendors breathing room). this lets MI300 land and gives us two buffer days for gaudi image bake. objections?
mira: +1 from lab capacity, but only if sam confirms image bake path is parallelizable.
sam: can parallelize some SI tests. main sequential blocker is vendor firmware signoff. if vendor signs provisional driver, we can run canary earlier.
jordana: i'll prep provisional marketplace tag workflow and draft the SKU mapping table. please list the exact fields you need for mapping.
alex: action items: Sam — confirm firmware ETA & whether vendor can sign provisional driver (due EOD). Jordana — provisional tag playbook + SKU mapping (due tomorrow). Mira — perf smoke run & pass/fail criteria (due Apr 20). Alex — vendor comms update and finalize announce order.
sam: tracker updated: https://rwd.internal/trackers/launch-deltas (will add firmware ticket id). firmware ETA updated in tracker.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-gaudi -> 1702400000 (manual approval required)
nate: will push vendor comms to request provisional signer for driver and ask about embargo flexibility windows. i'll cc legal on any provisional tag language.
alex: perfect. if any vendor pushes back, we use the H200 fallback mapping per runbook 3.2 and delay H100 press by a week.
jordana: drafting announcement language & ops mapping now. will post PR in #marketing when ready.
mira: scheduling short follow-up tomorrow 11am PT to ratify.
alex: thanks all — syncing tomorrow 11am PT. :raised_hands:
